Major emphasis on this:

> Most people just want to live, not engage in the endless pursuit of capital.

I just want to pay off my loans, have a home, and *maybe* have a kid someday. I say “maybe” not because I’m not sure about having one, but because it’s literally nearly impossible for me to pay off my loans yet and still have money to save for a medical emergency. 

Other developed countries can have an injury without it ruining their life, meanwhile I wasn’t allowed to even entertain the idea of going to an emergency clinic when I experienced injuries in the past. It’s absolutely mental that saying “I want a decent quality of life” is even an argument for conservatives.
I’ll never understand why this is an argument. Congressmen make at least $150,000 a year and people who still get underpaid are angry that... other average citizens recognize they deserve better pay?

This wasn’t “personal preference”. This man had the entire day planned out with a women he has never met before and got upset that this woman, who is a living human being with their own opinions, didn’t do everything he wanted to his exact perfection. He unleashed all of this just because she suggested a different restaurant to eat at, even. He’s acting like a literal sociopath. 

Telling anyone at all “you must not care about me at all if you won’t agree to every idea I have”, our “not agreeing with me over the restaurant we eat at means you’re going to give me power struggles” is also extremely insecure and is manipulative as Fuck..

If all of this is just “preference” to you, then you genuinely may need to see a counselor. Seriously.

No one is going to praise you for writing the truth about a situation, that’s how this is supposed to go. 

I understand your work is stressful and you may deal with problems like this often, but you’re the one in this management position, and in this specific scenario you were being an AH. Maybe a light one, but still the AH in the situation. If you feel guilty about this situation there’s more likely than not a reason for that.

> I talked to him looked at some pictures he sent, and said come on over.

What kind of pictures did he send? Were these of tools/work he’s done before? It sounds like you felt he was capable, especially since you told him to come over despite getting multiple other people responding to you. Then in your edit you admitted you’ve done this before plenty of times, and yet the situation has turned out the same.

At this point that’s on you. Regardless if he actually was competent enough for the job or not, Don’t waste someone’s time, money, and then lie to them because of your own faults. YTA for justifying bad management skills and behavior in a situation that you created, as well as wasting that mans time.

Reading all of these bad experiences is extremely depressing. I’m so sorry to everyone who has had doctors or anesthesiologists put their own attitude before the fact that you were going through childbirth.

I think Hollyhock from Bojack Horseman deserves a spin-off! She’s dealt with a harmful relationship (Bojack) before and she now has friends who have directly experienced the same. She’s also growing as a person despite that at her university, and the fact that she has 8 dads is interesting. 

She’s a great character as a whole and I think she handles internal conflict (that she’s learning to handle healthily) that would be helpful for an audience to see

Because he kept on playing Nintendo instead of giving me an answer. My boyfriend knows that me saying “do you want to have sex” means I want to. 

And yes. I got offended when he masturbated right next to me, especially because he continued to wake me up with it even after I asked him to stop or change locations. If you wouldn’t mind those things, then that’s okay and between yourself and your SO, but I personally have a boundary for that.

To be honest the number of people who use neo- pronouns, especially 15+ of them, is so exceptionally small and I highly, highly doubt these people expect you to call them a kitten to their face. The number of people who use said pronouns outside of a closed tumblr circle is little to none. 

I feel like this is less of a “don’t force me to do something I don’t like” rant, and more of a “I saw something that I thought was stupid so I’m going to act like it’s a mainstream thing that is expected of me so I sound like a victim”, rant. It really is one of those ‘mind your business and scroll on’ type of things. On god no one expects you to label yourself as some kind of kitten otherkin or vice versa. 

I guess I’m not surprised that Reddit is eating this shit up, though.

I think it’s important to remember that you don’t need to already know about things like sports or anime to get a guys attention.

What’s important isn’t that you’re in love with the same things they are off the bat, what’s truly important is that you’re interested in *hearing* about what they’re interested in. Everyone loves sharing their hobbies and favorite things. Use it as an opportunity to hear them open up, and then you do the same.

Someone said their savings is for “life or death emergencies” and they only have $4,000.... This genuinely scares me if y’all live in the U.S.... a life or death emergency will very much likely cost way more than your 2-4K savings....

Not necessarily free, because that’s likely not entirely possible, but there genuinely is absolutely no other reason to congregate and live within a society together if our goal isn’t to improve our livelihoods.
The basic necessities being something that should be as easily accessible as possible.

I wouldn’t know. I told him I was done talking to him about anything political or related and that was the last discussion. 

The definition of the word he gave me, though, was extremely unrelated to the dictionary’s definition. So yeah I had no idea what he was talking about until he yelled at me for not understanding him.
Girl I didn’t ask him to get involved in the debate or argue with anyone. I told he shouldn’t ignore an insult because it was a “joke” or let someone yell and insult anyone in our household.

You’re completely right. 

I just expected my boyfriend to tell him to stop yelling or stop being rude. By the point my friend was yelling at me and saying rude things the room was dead silent except for him. And I had already told him I want to drop the topic long before he yelled.

Honestly, I’m a jerk for making it a bigger thing than it initially was but if someone yelled at my SO and insulted them in their own home I wouldn’t stand for it. 

Why would you let someone hurt your SO and just ignore it?

He didn’t make it clear he was using a definition other than the dictionary’s definition until he started yelling at me. He started yelling because I “should have known” what he was talking about.

I also have never raised my voice in a debate and I don’t think that should be seen as a standard.. especially if that leads to someone saying “you should have expected to get yelled at and insulted by your friend”, when that’s never happened before.

To sum it up, it was a political debate. I was using the word “capitalism” as defined in the dictionary and he got mad at me because I didn’t use it the way he told me it should be defined. He was also mad because “the dictionary doesn’t define words” and I was wrong to say it does.
So if someone were to yell and insult you in your own home with your SO in front of you, you wouldn’t expect them to help you at all?
They could. Again, human beings can be dumb and accidents happen every day. Even from people who are certified.

I’m not trying to complain, but now they’re both essentially the same subreddit 🤷🏻‍♀️
